quarterly_data.quarter: Wärtsilä press release: Wrtsil closes the transaction of the joint venture for its (10-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Wärtsilä closed on 1 October 2026 the joint venture for its Energy Storage business with German engineering company RCT Solutions GmbH (agreed 15 June 2026): Wärtsilä and RCT Solutions each hold a 50% stake in the joint venture, called Valo. The Energy Storage business employs approximately 450 people and generated net sales of EUR 694 million in 2025; it ceased to be a separate reporting segment in the second quarter of 2026 and is reported in discontinued operations up to completion. During the third quarter of 2026 Wärtsilä recognised a write-down of capitalised R&D related to Energy Storage before the joint venture was established, rather than within it as previously expected; the joint venture is expected to generate an operating loss in 2026 and positive results towards the end of 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: 50% stake each; approximately 450 people; 2025 net sales EUR 694 million
